// PROBE (never compiled): an action that changes someone else's record and
// tells them nothing — the shape of every PW-BRIDGE-01 tier-1 interaction
// before Queue B. Kept red so the detector is proven to bite.

export async function revokeShare(grantId: string) {
    // Access ends here, and the grantee is never told.
    await db.accessGrant.update({
        where: { id: grantId },
        data: { status: "revoked", revokedAt: new Date() },
    })
    revalidatePath("/wallet")
    return { success: true }
}

export async function confirmPolicyReview(policyId: string) {
    // The owner's columns are overwritten by an agent; no emit anywhere.
    await db.policy.update({ where: { id: policyId }, data: { insurerName: "X" } })
    return { success: true }
}

// The counter-example: the same action, told. The detector must NOT flag this.
export async function revokeShareTold(grantId: string) {
    const grant = await db.accessGrant.update({
        where: { id: grantId },
        data: { status: "revoked" },
        select: { granteeUserId: true },
    })
    await emit({
        event: "policy_share_revoked",
        userId: grant.granteeUserId,
        title: { el: "…", en: "…" },
        message: { el: "…", en: "…" },
    })
    return { success: true }
}
